caption: An imagined guard with an appetite for the store.
alt: An ant stands at the entrance of an open wooden box containing jaggery.

caption: A winged ant, pictured without a prediction of its fate.
alt: A winged ant rests on the edge of a leaf.

caption: An imagined contrast: a wide passage for the elephant, a twig across the ant’s path.
alt: An elephant walks through an open gateway while a foreground ant faces a twig.

caption: An ant climbing an unlit lampstand.
alt: A small ant climbs the broad base of a tall unlit metal lampstand.

caption: An imagined difference of scale: fallen leaves beside an elephant and ants.
alt: An elephant eats leaves while enlarged foreground ants stand near fallen foliage.

caption: An indirect illustration of unequal scale: ants on a rock above shallow water, an elephant beyond.
alt: Ants stand on a rock in shallow water while an elephant walks away in the distance.

caption: Keeping the sweet store covered.
alt: A hand lowers a domed cover over jaggery on a tray as ants approach along the shelf.

caption: Two imagined lines: people approaching a gathering and ants crossing the foreground.
alt: A curving line of people in everyday clothing walks toward a simple canopy while a separate line of ants echoes the curve.

caption: Drawn towards sweetness.
alt: Several ants approach and climb a small rough lump of jaggery.
